resources.string: Lets your chatbot read and change the design open in the editor through your own relay. Each change is one step you can undo, and a design that fails the sewing check is not changed. Removing objects asks you here first. Saving, sharing and sending to USB stay with you. The key stays on this device and is not in backups.
Enter a wss:// address and the APP_KEY.
Your chatbot wants to remove: %1$s. Nothing is removed unless you agree within 90 seconds.
